name: dialoga
description: Build tooling for the Dialoga WordPress plugin.

scripts.test: npm run build && php tests/flow-transfer-test.php && php tests/i18n-test.php && php tests/settings-test.php && node tests/canvas-build-test.cjs && node tests/canvas-browser-test.cjs
scripts.check:report: wp-env run cli --config=.wp-env.package.json wp plugin check dialoga --format=strict-json > plugin-check-report.json
scripts.check:package: npm run package && wp-env start --config=.wp-env.package.json && wp-env run cli --config=.wp-env.package.json wp plugin install plugin-check --activate --force && wp-env run cli --config=.wp-env.package.json wp plugin install /var/www/html/tmp/dialoga-package/dialoga.zip --force --activate && wp-env run cli --config=.wp-env.package.json wp plugin check dialoga
